sources.title: Wikidata Q11259 (Times Square) and Q1139633 (One Times Square)

centralTowerM.note: One Times Square height (P2048) 363 ft: the generic screen tower at the square's south end

squareLengthM.note: the bowtie's length along Broadway and Seventh Avenue, 42nd to 47th Street (five blocks of about 80 m)

plazaWidthM.note: the square's width at its ends (widthM) and at its waist (depthM), proportioned by eye

heightM.note: the tallest flanking tower: the model's top

flankLowM.note: the lowest flanking tower; the others are interpolated, generic

readabilityScale.note: A composed, generic district: blocks with window bands and plain colour screen panels. No text, logos or brands (LEGAL-1).

gameScale.note: Real scale: the square is a district of real-size blocks; its screens, not its size, make it read.
